title: Silver Bay Stables
specs: Indoor and outdoor arenas allow lessons in most weather conditions except very cold or strong wind.
Everyone must wear an ATSM certified equestrian helmet while riding or working with horses.
Long pants and boots with a heel are required; sneakers, shorts, and open toed shoes are not permitted.
Weight limit is 250 pounds for beginner riders; higher for experienced riders with good balance.

blurb: Silver Bay Stables offers riding lessons for all levels including beginner riders and adults. They provide horse time experiences such as brushing and riding lessons. Lessons are held in indoor and outdoor arenas and include safety rules such as wearing helmets and appropriate footwear.
extraNote: Cancellation required 24 hours before a lesson; cancellations under 24 hours will be charged. · Payment required 24 hours before lesson time; lessons suspended if not paid. · No refunds available; payments can be held for 6 months. · Lessons may be cancelled due to weather for safety; contact provided phone number if cancelled. · Late arrivals over 30 minutes will not be able to do the lesson and will be charged.
